thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Autoscaler ceiling hit for gpu-pool-west. Current node count at configured max=180, pending queue growth observed. Scaling blocked by maxNodes policy. Pager: @oncall-jane

oncall-jane: seeing it, joining now. queue length reported ~18.2k jobs, ingress rate +22% last 5m. any ongoing deploys? :eyes:

sre-tom: no deploys from infra team. autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts bumped by maxNodes check. also OOM throttles on a few pods -> some churn.

eng-runtime-lee: confirming p95 latency for generation requests jumped to 2.8s -> 9.4s depending on model. throughput has dropped 35%. customers hitting timeouts.

infra-pat: cloud quota for GPUs in region shows soft cap at 200 nodes, we set pool maxNodes=180 due to account limits and safety. current used=180, requested=192 in the last 10m per autoscaler. provider won't spin >200 without support case.

support-leo: getting customer reports from prod-SLAs: two larger customers see errors 503 and request timeouts. tallying customers impacted: sandbox and production pockets. I'll start a triage ticket with CSMs.

product-maya: which customers? need quick impact summary for AE pages.

support-leo: ACME-Infra (prod), Greenfin (batch pipelines), small percent of legacy partners. estimated impacted requests 0.6% of total but concentrated on long-sequence workloads.

oncall-jane: immediate mitigation plan: 1) try temporary pod-level throttling to shed heavy batch workers, 2) manual node cap raise request to infra team, 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for non-critical tenants. will coordinate.

sre-tom: agree. also suggest enabling aggressive prefix caching for chat routes to reduce token work. can push quick config change to runtime in 5m.

eng-runtime-lee: I can flip cache policy for chat and embeddings. rolling change in runtime-config: cache.enabled=true, cache.evictionTTL=600s. Might reduce load by ~12-18% for repeated prompts.

oncall-jane: do it. include a health check after.

ops-bot: @oncall-jane initiated runbook: "autoscale-ceiling-mitigation". Steps: collect backlog, evaluate quota, if manual bump approved, apply node bump via infra ticket.

infra-pat: I'm on the node bump path. quick check: current cloud-account region quota allows 200 max; raising to 220 requires support ticket + 2-4h approval. we can temporarily increase pool.maxNodes to 200 immediately (unsafe beyond that). Anyone object?

eng-runtime-lee: let's take it to 200. we'll monitor latency.

oncall-jane: +1. please execute and post confirmation. also start fallback routing rules for non-prem customers now.

infra-pat: applying pool config change: updating k8s autoscaler annotation maxNodes=200 -> running command now:```kubectl annotate hpa gpu-pool autoscaler.alpha.kubernetes.io/maxNodes=200 --overwrite```

ops-bot: autoscaler-controller: detected config change, reconciling. expected nodes target increase allowed.

infra-pat: cloud provider API returning capacity delayed. new nodes requested: 12. provisioning in progress. ETA ~6-12m.

support-leo: posting interim customer note: "Some requests may see higher latency or transient errors while we scale. Working on resolving, ETA 30-45m." Hoping to reduce escalations.

product-maya: thanks. flagging high-value customer ACME-Infra with account team.

eng-runtime-lee: fallback routing in place: non-SLA tenants to model-x-small. config snippet applied:```route: /generate
  priority: normal
  fallback_model: model-x-small
  percentage: 70``` should divert load immediately.

oncall-jane: monitoring queue and p95. current queue 17.9k -> 15.2k after routing change. p95 down 9.4s -> 5.6s. progress.

sre-tom: nodes provisioning status: 6 nodes up within last 4m, kubelet join ok for 5, one stuck in NotReady (driver install). investigating.

infra-pat: driver issue: nvidia-driver provisioner failing due to image pull rate limit on our bootstrap mesh. kicking a retry. manual workaround applied to mount local driver cache on stuck node. should join in ~3m.

oncall-jane: good. keep me posted. Any sign autoscaler continuing to attempt >200?

sre-tom: autoscaler shows desired=205 then clipped to 200 by maxNodes. we need to watch for pending pods staying in Pending due to node provisioning lag.

eng-runtime-lee: to buy time, I'll scale down batch workers:```kubectl scale deploy/batch-workers --replicas=10``` reducing CPU/GPU demand. Batch backlog might slow but avoids more throttles.

support-leo: batch jobs owners notified. they'll accept temporary slowdown. sending message to paging list for any urgent customer issues.

oncall-jane: update: nodes stabilized at 198 after final join. queue down to 9.4k, p95 3.1s. still some 503 spikes for long sequences, but trending down.

product-maya: good outcome so far. what's the ETA for full backlog drain?

sre-tom: at current throughput estimate ~45m to clear backlog to normal levels. will re-evaluate in 15m increments.

infra-pat: follow-up: we should request region quota increase with cloud provider to allow permanent pool.maxNodes bump to 260 for runway. I'll open a support case and attach logs.

oncall-jane: open ticket now and add me + infra-pat as contacts. Also create an incident ticket for postmortem with initial severity S3. We'll escalate if customer impact widens.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-2205556677, severity S3, owner=@oncall-jane.

support-leo: sent customer comms update: "Backlog is being processed, we have increased capacity temporarily. Some long-running requests may still see errors for up to 1 hour. We're monitoring and will follow up." 

eng-runtime-lee: note for postmortem: consider autoscaler policy change to allow temporary emergency override > maxNodes with manual approval workflow, or hook to emergency provider quota.

product-maya: also request we add per-customer telemetry to detect concentrated impact earlier. tagging @eng-runtime and @sre-tom for implementation plan.

oncall-jane: final update at +10m: backlog 4.6k, p95 2.2s, errors tapering. I'll keep watch until fully stable. handing off to day oncall @sre-tom in 30m.

sre-tom: taking handoff at 30m. will verify node stability and follow-up on quota request.

infra-pat: support case opened: CLOUD-247862, requested quota to 260 GPUs in region. ETA from provider 4-8h. Also filed internal change to pool.maxNodes=220 pending provider approval; requires infra review.

oncall-jane: closing note: mitigation successful, manual cap bump to 200 allowed temporary recovery. action items created: [1] PM telemetry for concentrated queue alerts (owner: product-maya), [2] autoscaler emergency override design (owner: eng-runtime-lee), [3] provider quota increase follow-up (owner: infra-pat).

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-2205556677 updated: status=mitigated, mitigated_at=2205557277.

oncall-jane: signing off. If anything spikes, re-pager. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
